sources.role: fltkui (SDL2) config/save/state/input/bios handling for linux and macos
win32 UI configuration, paths, input and FDS sources for windows
linux/macos build status and transition to Nestopia JG + QTea
release assets: 1.53.2 ships win32 only; linux/macos build from source

paths.path: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nestopia/ (fallback ~/.config/nestopia/) containing nestopia.conf and input.conf; nestopia.conf is INI with a [frontend] section and a [nestopia] core section (controller port device selection port1/port2/port3/port4/portexp lives in [nestopia])
evidence: source:fltkui/setmanager.cpp L163-177 confpath from XDG_CONFIG_HOME else $HOME/.config/<coreinfo.name>, coreinfo.name = "nestopia"
source:fltkui/setmanager.cpp L214-243 writes '; Nestopia UE Configuration File', [frontend] and [<core>] sections plus input.conf
source:fltkui/jg.cpp settings_nst[] port1/port2/port3/port4/portexp device strings (tag 1.53.2)
docs:README.unix@1.48 legacy SDL port used ~/.nestopia/nestopia.conf - superseded by XDG layout in 1.53.x fltkui

paths.path: input.conf in the config directory (same dir as nestopia.conf): one INI section per emulated device (nespad1, nespad2, ..., plus "ui") whose values are raw SDL keysym integers, and a sibling <device>j section per device for joysticks using codes j<button>b<N>, j<button>h<N>, j<button>a<N>; pad buttons are Up/Down/Left/Right/Select/Start/A/B/TurboA/TurboB
evidence: source:fltkui/inputmanager.cpp remap_kb() L161-217 (keysym ints per device+button name) and remap_js() L220-298 (jN.b/jN.h/jN.a pattern)
source:fltkui/inputmanager.cpp set_inputdef() L301-389 writes the same jN.* codes back
source:fltkui/jg/jg_nes.h defs_nespad (tag 1.53.2)

paths.naming: battery/EEPROM/tape/turbofile saves are <rom filename stem>.sav in the save dir; Famicom Disk System disk data is persisted as a UPS patch <rom filename stem>.ups in the same save dir (IPS patches are only auto-applied on load)
evidence: source:fltkui/jgmanager.cpp set_paths() L114-132 (XDG_DATA_HOME/nestopia base, save = base + /save)
source:fltkui/jg.cpp nst_cb_files LOAD/SAVE_BATTERY..SAVE_TURBOFILE L416-441 (<pathinfo.save>/<gameinfo.name>.sav)
source:fltkui/jg.cpp LOAD_FDS/SAVE_FDS L445-470 (<save>/<game>.ups, User::File::PATCH_UPS)
source:fltkui/jgmanager.cpp load_game() L98 gamename = rom filename stem

paths.naming: quick-save slots are <rom filename stem>_<slot>.nst with slot = 0..4 (menu Slot 0..Slot 4); File > Save State writes a user-chosen *.nst file
evidence: source:fltkui/jgmanager.cpp state_qload/state_qsave L194-227 (basepath + /state/ + gamename + _ + slot + .nst)
source:fltkui/fltkui.cpp L120-124 quick save menu Slot 0..4, L367/L397 'Nestopia States\t*.nst' filter
source:fltkui/jgmanager.cpp set_paths() L134-136 creates state/ and screenshots/ dirs

paths.path: $XDG_DATA_HOME/nestopia/ (fallback ~/.local/share/nestopia/) is the bios/user-asset path; core assets (NstDatabase.xml, palettes) come from the install datadir ($(datadir)/nestopia)
paths.naming: no BIOS for base NES cartridge/NSF play; Famicom Disk System requires disksys.rom in the base path (or an auxiliary BIOS supplied by the frontend); lunchbox db has no nestopia firmware_rules entries to import it
evidence: source:fltkui/jgmanager.cpp set_paths() L114-148 (pathinfo.bios = basepath; corepath = NST_DATADIR)
source:fltkui/jg.cpp jg_game_load() L1425-1459 FDS: uses aux bios else pathinfo.bios + /disksys.rom, logs 'Failed to load FDS BIOS'
source:Makefile.am databasedir = $(datadir)/nestopia (tag 1.53.2)
db:firmware_rules catalog sources/firmware-rules.json has 124 rules and no nestopia entry (verified 2026-09-11)

linux.notes: Captured from the 1.53.2 FLTK/SDL2 UI (the current 0ldsk00l GUI); the 1.4x SDL port it replaced kept everything in ~/.nestopia/ instead. Lunchbox launches with a private data root; native saves/states stay in the XDG locations.

paths.path: nestopia.xml next to nestopia.exe by default; if launched with the -lua flag the config lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Nestopia\nestopia.xml (this fork renamed the classic upstream NESTOPIA.CFG to nestopia.xml, same XML Configuration format)
evidence: source:win32/NstApplicationConfiguration.cpp L67-68/L141-142 loads and saves Instance::GetConfigPath(L"nestopia.xml") (tag 1.53.2)
source:win32/NstApplicationInstance.cpp Instance ctor L104-149 (configPath = GetModuleFileName dir, or CSIDL_LOCAL_APPDATA + \Nestopia under -lua) and GetConfigPath() L307-310

paths.path: inside nestopia.xml: [input]/keys/<device> with DirectInput DIK_* codes per button (pad-1/pad-2/pad-3/pad-4, powerpad, powerglove, horitrack, pachinko, ... plus emulation/file/machine/nsf/view/help command sections); [input]/joysticks holds per-device GUID and axis/button mappings; port device selection is [machine]/adapter (auto|nes|famicom) and [machine]/port-1..port-5 with values pad1..pad4, zapper, paddle, powerpad, powerglove, mouse, rob, familytrainer, familykeyboard, suborkeyboard, doremikkokeyboard, horitrack, pachinko, ...
evidence: source:win32/NstDialogInput.cpp Settings::map L151-171 ("pad-1","left"->DIK_LEFT, "pad-1","start"->DIK_RETURN, "pad-1","a"->DIK_PERIOD, ...) and Load/Save L543-560, L640-708 (input/keys, input/joysticks)
source:win32/NstManagerInput.cpp Input::Load L221-260 (machine/adapter, machine/port-# strings) and Input::Save L340-375 (machine/port-x = pad1|zapper|paddle|...)

paths.path: the Paths dialog saves directory (config key paths/saves/directory), default save\ relative to the application directory; FDS patch files use the paths/patches/directory, default patches\
paths.naming: battery/EEPROM saves are <rom base filename>.sav; FDS disk data is saved as <rom base filename>.ups in the patches directory (auto-applied patches may also fall back to .ips on load)
evidence: source:win32/NstManagerPaths.cpp GetSavePath() L368-383 (DIR_SAVE dir + image file + L"sav" for cartridges, DIR_PATCHES + .ups otherwise)
source:win32/NstDialogPaths.cpp dirs table L76-77 (DIR_SAVE default L"save\\", DIR_PATCHES L"patches\\") and Save() L304-316 (paths/saves/directory, paths/states/directory)
source:win32/NstManagerPaths.cpp GetPatchPath() L385-396 (.ups then .ips fallback)

paths.path: the Paths dialog states directory (config key paths/states/directory), default states\ relative to the application directory
paths.naming: File > Save State writes <rom base filename>.nst (optionally zlib-compressed per paths/states/use-compression); the 9 quick slots live in memory and are auto-imported/exported (default on) as <rom base filename>.ns1 .. .ns9 in the states directory
evidence: source:win32/NstManagerPaths.cpp L135-137 (extension LUT: BATTERY sav, STATE|SLOTS nst) and GetDefaultDirectory L258-283 (STATE|SLOTS|MOVIE -> DIR_STATE)
source:win32/NstManagerSaveStates.cpp ExportSlot/ImportSlots L293-330 (path.Extension() = L"ns1"; path.Back() = '1' + index; 9 slots)
source:win32/NstManagerSaveStates.cpp L352-358 Save State -> STATE file, NstDialogPaths.cpp L88-94 auto-import/auto-export/compress defaults

paths.path: FDS BIOS file configured in the FDS dialog (config key fds/bios); the default resolves to disksys.rom looked up through the file search paths (application/image directories); no BIOS is used for cartridge or NSF play
paths.naming: disksys.rom; when absent the FDS dialog prompts for a BIOS file and warns IDS_FDS_ERR_INVALIDBIOS on invalid images
evidence: source:win32/NstDialogFds.cpp L91-106 (fds/bios, default "disksys.rom" via paths.FindFile) and L136-165 (QueryBiosFile/SubmitBios -> Fds::SetBIOS)
source:win32/NstManagerFds.cpp L298-300 EVENT_DISK_QUERY_BIOS -> dialog->QueryBiosFile()

windows.notes: The win32 UI keeps everything portable beside the exe unless -lua is passed; the only release artifact at 1.53.2 is nestopia_1.53.2-win32.zip.

paths.path: same fltkui build as linux, so the identical code paths apply: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nestopia/ else ~/.config/nestopia/ with nestopia.conf + input.conf (XDG vars are normally unset on macOS, so the $HOME fallbacks are what users see)
evidence: source:fltkui/setmanager.cpp L163-172 platform-independent XDG fallback logic (tag 1.53.2)
docs:README.md Linux/macOS Build section (autotools fltkui build; project is transitioning to Nestopia JG + QTea)
docs:configure.ac@1.53.2 L84-91 requires fltk-config on all hosts, darwin* branch for link flags

paths.path: input.conf in the config directory, identical linux format: per-device INI sections (nespad1, ..., ui) with SDL keysym integers and <device>j sections with jN.b/jN.h/jN.a joystick codes
evidence: source:fltkui/inputmanager.cpp remap_kb/remap_js (SDL2 keyboard codes, platform-independent, tag 1.53.2)
docs:README.md Linux/macOS Build section (single fltkui frontend shared by linux and macOS)

paths.naming: <rom filename stem>.sav for battery/EEPROM/tape/turbofile; FDS disk data as <rom filename stem>.ups UPS patch in the same directory
evidence: source:fltkui/jgmanager.cpp set_paths() L114-132 (no #ifdef around the XDG fallback, so macOS uses $HOME/.local/share/nestopia)
source:fltkui/jg.cpp nst_cb_files L416-470 (.sav and .ups naming, tag 1.53.2)

paths.naming: quick slots <rom filename stem>_<slot>.nst, slot 0..4; File > Save State writes *.nst
evidence: source:fltkui/jgmanager.cpp L134-136, L194-227 (state dir + slot naming, platform-independent)
source:fltkui/fltkui.cpp L120-124 (Slot 0..4 menu)

paths.path: $XDG_DATA_HOME/nestopia/ else ~/.local/share/nestopia/ as bios/user path; core assets from the install datadir
paths.naming: disksys.rom required only for Famicom Disk System titles; no firmware needed for cartridge/NSF; lunchbox db firmware_rules has no nestopia entries
evidence: source:fltkui/jg.cpp jg_game_load() L1433-1455 (pathinfo.bios + /disksys.rom fallback)
db:firmware_rules catalog sources/firmware-rules.json has no nestopia entry (verified 2026-09-11)
docs:GitHub releases - no macOS binary asset at 1.53.2, macOS users build from source (make dist / autotools)

macos.notes: macOS is source-build only at 1.53.2 (no release asset); the autotools build has an explicit darwin branch and shares the fltkui frontend, so linux and macOS layouts match with $HOME fallbacks instead of XDG env vars.
